individual-data-points.explanation: Panel A shows super-resolution reconstructions/localization maps (micrograph type), not a plot of averaged data; individual data points requirement does not apply.
Panel B shows super-resolution reconstructions/localization maps, not a quantitative plot; requirement does not apply.
Dot plot of number of clusters/cell with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Dot plot of cluster sizes with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cluster, as stated in the caption.
Dot plot of percentage of molecules in clusters with mean ± SEM overlaid on individual gray dots representing each cell, as stated in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution reconstructions and trajectory maps, not a quantitative averaged plot; requirement does not apply.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients and bottom is a line plot of mean square displacement per trajectory; both plot types are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
Panel H shows trajectory maps and a kymograph (micrograph-type visualizations), not an averaged quantitative plot; requirement does not apply.
